extension_activated.description: Triggered when the RML Dev Server extension is activated upon opening a Turtle or RML document.

evaluate.description: Triggered when evaluating a mapping expression or node in the Evaluator & Value Inspector.

data_context_type.description: EvaluationDataContext subtype: all, range, rawString, referenceValues, multiSource.

plan_node_expanded.description: Triggered when a node in the execution plan tree hierarchy is expanded.

inline_evaluate_hover.description: Triggered when a user hovers over an inline evaluation hint in the editor to inspect values.

hint_label.description: Summary label of the inspected inlay hint.

hint_kind.description: Kind of the inlay hint (parameter or type).

validation_diagnostic_hover.description: Triggered when a user hovers over a validation diagnostic message in the editor.

rerCodeUri.description: RER error or diagnostic code URI.

abstract_logical_source_view.description: Triggered when viewing sample source data or a logical view.

source_type.description: Type of source (e.g. LogicalView, JSONSourceRFC, XMLSource, CSVSource).

trace_from_source.description: Triggered when tracing iteration dataflow starting from a source iteration.

trace_from_statement.description: Triggered when tracing provenance dataflow from a generated output statement quad.

run_mapping.description: Triggered when the user requests mapping materialization execution.

trigger_source.description: UI entry point used to launch execution (editor_title, command_palette).

mapping_execution_completed.description: Emitted when mapping execution completes, recording execution duration and triple count scale.

triples_magnitude.description: Order of magnitude bucket for triples generated.

trace_execution_completed.description: Emitted when trace generation completes, recording trace duration and graph scale.

trace_node_magnitude.description: Order of magnitude bucket for trace nodes.

visualise_rdf.description: Triggered when opening the RDF graph/table visualizer on an RDF document.

execution_view_mode_changed.description: Triggered when switching between Table and Graph views in the execution results.

execution_group_by_changed.description: Triggered when changing the quad grouping in the execution table.

execution_filter_applied.description: Triggered when setting or clearing column filters or searches in the execution table.

filter_kind.description: Whether this is a search or a filter.

column.description: Column name filtered (subject, predicate, object, graph, target).

filter_type.description: Specific filter or search type applied (text, term_type, datatype, language).

is_active.description: Whether a filter or search string is currently active.

execution_scroll_loaded_more.description: Triggered when scrolling in the execution table loads an additional batch of rows.

view_type.description: Type of view scrolled (flat or grouped).

reached_end.description: Whether the user scrolled to the end of all results.

execution_partition_changed.description: Triggered when selecting a target or graph partition tab in execution results.

is_all.description: Whether the All partition tab is selected.

execution_rerun_clicked.description: Triggered when re-running mapping execution from within the execution view.

clear_cache.description: Whether cache was cleared prior to re-running.

$exception.description: Captures unhandled exceptions or error reports.

handled.description: Whether the error was caught and handled.
